title: Steroid Equivalent Dosing
sources: Standard endocrinology references; UpToDate glucocorticoid equivalency

changelog.change: Initial entry from Calculator_Logic_Build_Spec.md Section 3 — modelled as a reference table rather than a formula calculator.

summary: Approximate equipotent (anti-inflammatory) glucocorticoid doses. Mineralocorticoid activity and duration of action differ and are not captured by dose equivalence alone.

body.text: Equivalence covers anti-inflammatory potency only. Hydrocortisone and cortisone have substantial mineralocorticoid activity; dexamethasone has essentially none. When replacing a physiologic (adrenal-insufficiency) regimen, account for mineralocorticoid need separately (e.g. fludrocortisone).
Worked example: prednisone 40 mg ≈ methylprednisolone 32 mg ≈ dexamethasone 6 mg ≈ hydrocortisone 160 mg.

buildNote: Kept as a static reference table — a bare mg-ratio 'calculator' invites unsafe use across agents with different mineralocorticoid activity and half-life. If a calculator is added later, force an explicit agent-pair selection and surface the duration/mineralocorticoid caveat inline.
